results.evidence: Rendered text of all 23 /preview/arena views at 390 and 1440, read in full. Disclaimer or filler lines remain. Ranks: 'It is separate from your CUET exam rank' and 'Nobody else is named here.' Rival: 'simulated benchmark, not a student or a CUET rank prediction.' Compass: 'not a prediction; ... Your subjects and score stay on this device'. Join/Mob: 'Scores stay private unless you choose', 'Off by default... Never a ranking', 'MockMob never asks for your contacts.' Explore: 'This is practice, separate from your timed mock score.' Upload: 'No credit reward is promised', 'Submission does not mean publication.' Ask Mobi/Today/Progress: 'A practice observation, not a diagnosis', 'not a causal score gain'. Public footer on every marketing page, and About 'Independent, and clear about it': 'not affiliated with NTA, the University of Delhi or any official exam body.' Numbers are real: 1,404 questions, 40 credits, 3 of 4 sat, 8 of 23 changes.
results.problem: Non-affiliation, 'just a practice' and privacy lines are still on screen in many places, which is exactly what the owner said should not be written.
results.fix: Delete these sentences: ranks 'separate from your CUET exam rank' and 'Nobody else is named here'; rival 'simulated benchmark, not a student or a CUET rank prediction'; explore 'This is practice, separate from your timed mock score'; join/mob privacy and 'never a ranking' lines; upload 'No credit reward is promised' and 'Submission does not mean publication'; the 'not a diagnosis' and 'not a causal score gain' tags; the non-affiliation footer sentence on MarketingFooter and the About 'Independent, and clear about it' block. Keep only legal text on /terms and /privacy. Keep concrete facts, and move any genuinely needed consent copy into the setting itself.

results.evidence: Pricing: 'There is no fixed set of mocks: each paper is built when you start it, from a live bank of 5,941 questions... Pro covers as many as you take; on Free, each one uses practice credits', and the FAQ 'As many as you take'. Start menu (dashboard 1440 Night, viewed): 'Every paper is built fresh from the 1,404 Accountancy questions in the bank... There is no cap on how many you take, only the practice credits each one uses.' Result: 'Take another fresh paper... There is no cap on how many papers you take.' results.problem: Onboarding says only 'Each mock in a subject is a fresh paper from its question bank.' It never says there is no cap on mocks, so it covers half of the claim.
results.fix: Extend ONBOARDING_LEAD in src/lib/paperCopy.mjs: 'Pick up to 5. Every mock is a fresh paper from one live question bank, and there is no cap on how many you take. You can change them any time.' Keep the data/tests copy test in step.

results.evidence: Rendered /pricing at 390 and 1440, Night and Day (1440 Day viewed). It reads 'Rs 99 gets you in', the card shows 'Rs 99 once', 'covers access through 31 July 2027, with no renewal', and the CTA is 'Get access for Rs 99'. The FAQ answers 'Is Pro a monthly subscription?' with 'Not yet.' The monthly branch (Pro Rs 99 /month, renewal on the same date, cancel in Account) only renders when env RAZORPAY_PLAN_ID_PRO_MONTHLY_99 is set. This dev build does not set it: .env.local sets only the older _PRO_MONTHLY variable. Git history since 15 Oct shows copy changes and PricingCard edits only. The layout is the same as 15 Oct (two cards, comparison table, FAQ). Positives: real rupees, included usage (10 and 50 practice credits, 100 start credits) and no fake reference prices, countdowns or loss threats.
results.problem: The plan is not presented as 99 a month, and there is no visible typography or visual upgrade over 15 Oct (the owner's 'pricing seems the same' complaint stands). Whether the live deploy shows monthly depends entirely on an env var.
results.fix: Make the monthly presentation the default for display: show 'Pro Rs 99 a month, renews monthly, cancel anytime' as the plan, and keep the checkout button on the one-time flow or 'coming online' until Razorpay is reconfigured. Alternatively set RAZORPAY_PLAN_ID_PRO_MONTHLY_99 on the deploy. Then do a real design pass on /pricing: a large price numeral, a plan header and a credits/usage strip (Free 100 credits, Pro unlimited, AI credits 10 vs 50), a renewal line, and a sticky Pro card. Capture it at 390 and 1440 Night and Day against the 15 Oct screenshot.

results.evidence: Models: providerCore.js has an allowlist (openai gpt-6-luna, anthropic claude-haiku-5-5) checked in callOnce before any client call (line 293). The only AI call sites are Ask Mobi (replyDeps), Mistake Repair, Rival (start and submit) and moderation, all through generateAIResponse. There are no other SDK or fetch calls to other providers (grep of src). reserve_runtime_ai refuses other models in the DB. Caps: STATUS.md says production was set by hand to Rs 5 paid (0.0568) and Rs 1 free (0.0114) at 2:35 am on 17 Oct. But the repo migration 20261017120000_runtime_ai_user_cap.sql seeds student_user_paid at 0.1136 (Rs 10), and data/tests/ai_user_cap.test.mjs asserts 0.1136. I did not touch any database, so the live value is unverified.
results.problem: The repository source of truth says Rs 10 paid. Any fresh or restored database gets Rs 10 and the test enforces the wrong number. COST_TABLE still lists old model names (telemetry only, harmless).
results.fix: Add a follow-up migration, or edit the seed, setting student_user_paid monthly_cap_usd to 0.0568. Update the test to 0.0568 and the header comment to Rs 5. Have the owner's ops confirm the live row. Optionally prune COST_TABLE to the two allowed models.
